CBs Trent McDuffie (back) and Jaylen Watson (shoulder) both left Sunday's win over the Chargers; Watson was ruled out for the rest of the game.

DL: DTs Daron Payne (foot) and Javon Kinlaw (knee) both inactive for SNF vs. Philadelphia.

PHI.text: WRs DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) out a second straight game. Tanner McKee has started 3 games with Jalen Hurts shut down for the season.

CIN.text: Secondary: CB DJ Turner II (ankle) ruled out mid-game vs. Tennessee; S Kyle Dugger (quadriceps) inactive.

DEN.text: Safeties: Talanoa Hufanga (ankle) inactive; Brandon Jones (hamstring) left Sunday's win over Kansas City and was ruled out.

KC.text: CBs Mansoor Delane (shoulder) downgraded to out and L'Jarius Sneed (knee) placed on IR before Week 8 at Denver.

GB.text: OL: OT Travis Glover (knee) and G Sean Rhyan (ankle) inactive in Week 8 vs. Carolina. LB Zaire Franklin (shin) also out.
Edge Micah Parsons reportedly closing in on a November return.

CAR.text: OL: G Damien Lewis (knee) out and RT Taylor Moton (lower leg) on IR. Secondary also thin: CB Akayleb Evans (triceps) to IR, CB Will Lee III (hamstring) hurt Thursday.

NE.text: Pass catchers: WR A.J. Brown (ankle) inactive at Miami; TE Hunter Henry (foot) ruled out mid-game.

JAX.text: Safeties: Antonio Johnson (ankle) inactive and Eric Murray (elbow) left Sunday's win over IND. DE Travon Walker (ribs) also hurt; RT Anton Harrison (ACL) on IR.

LAC.text: S Derwin James Jr. (hamstring) placed on injured reserve.

TB.text: WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) inactive again in Week 8 vs. Atlanta.

NYJ.text: Edge David Bailey, the team's sacks leader, inactive (groin) vs. Las Vegas.

ARI.text: WR Michael Wilson said he suffered two broken ribs in Sunday's win at Dallas; listed questionable.

DAL.text: S Caleb Downs ruled out of Sunday's loss to Arizona to be evaluated for a concussion.
